title: Code for: Do Blood-Count-Based Dengue Classifiers Generalize Across Clinical Cohorts? A Leakage-Free External Validation and Data-Integrity Audit of Public Bangladeshi Datasets
description: Analysis code, results and figures for a leakage-free bidirectional external validation of complete-blood-count-based dengue classifiers between two public Bangladeshi cohorts, with a data-integrity audit of four public datasets and controlled reproductions of leakage-prone pipelines. Version 1.1.0 adds a third external cohort, duplicate-aware cross-validation and additional sensitivity analyses requested in review.
